title: "Pyramid UFO" - NEW FOOTAGE. It's Just Bokeh, not a Pyramid
summary: Mick West shows new night-vision reference footage indicating the Navy's supposed flying pyramid UFO is just an out-of-focus light, likely a plane near LAX, rendered triangular by bokeh. He identifies other lights as Jupiter and stars.
why: HN cites it as a concise debunking of a UFO case and an illustration of how a triangular aperture creates triangle UFOs.

quote.text: The linked video in the article showing how a triangle iris creates triangle ufos is brilliant, and seems obvious after you see it.
